_about: Hayden's own gym clips, 30 Oct 2026, trimmed to the lift. tap = where a coach would tap, normalised to the upright frame. expect: ok (must measure, verdict ok), ask (check or choose is fine, a silent ok is only fine if every other check passes), refuse (must not answer ok). reps: exact count, null when not gated.
